fields.summary: Savepoint safety checks are missing for cleaner policy KEEP_LATEST_FILE_VERSIONS
fields.description:
You can currently savepoint to an invalid commit when the {{KEEP_LATEST_FILE_VERSIONS}} is enabled. The earliest commit to retain will never be set in the clean metadata so the check allows you to savepoint any commit, regardless of whether the files are present.

We should make a very conservative check here and inspect whether there is any clean commit after the instant of interest. If there is and it is not the commit immediately after the commit of interest, then fail.
